messages:
Nina Patel: Quick idea — for the benchmark launch, instead of the usual "latency vs cost" slide, what if we tell a product-first 'affordance map' story: show user journeys (interactive quick replies -> bulk/econ throughput) and tie each to a concrete chart + demo path. want quick reactions before design sync.
Sam Ortiz: do you mean highlighting batching/caching gains and fallback routing? can we show p50 + dollars/1k tokens side-by-side?
Priya Rao: yup — and include inbound lead routing: fast self-serve demo vs schedule-a-dedicated-deepdive. copy needs to map to two CTAs.
Ben Chu: I can draft a two-panel visual: left = 'instant path' (tail latency), right = 'throughput path' (cost curve). will try a quick mock in figma in 30m.
Marta Gomez: love the framing. tagline idea: "From instant replies to cost-effective scale." short + product-y.
Sam Ortiz: data for the chart — quick sample points for design to mock; we should show diminishing returns when you bend for lower cost.
Sam Ortiz (code): ```
latency_ms,cost_per_1k
50,12.5
90,9.0
150,6.2
300,3.8
800,1.1
```
Priya Rao: also add a small row for model variants (full fp16 -> quantized) and a routing threshold. suggestion: if p50 < 120ms -> route to hosted fastpath; otherwise surface 'economy demo' or schedule dedicated.
Nina Patel: can we capture 3 KPIs on the slide for each path: p50 latency, tokens/sec, $/1k? those map to developer, product, and finance personas respectively. also need a 2-min demo script for the webinar: show instant prompt -> switch to batch workload -> highlight unit economics.
Ben Chu: putting the initial comps at: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/bench-affordance-map — putting screens under page 'affordance-map'. placeholders for charts and microcopy.
Priya Rao: I'll wire the lead routing playbook: simple rules + tracking events. draft email subject options: 'See latency that scales' / 'Choose speed or scale — your call'. will A/B test.
Marta Gomez: note on tone: avoid 'cheap' or 'cheapest' phrasing. use 'cost-effective' / 'economical at scale' and call out SLA + graceful fallback. also will draft two post options: 1) narrative-driven launch post, 2) short data-first announcement.
affinity-bot: Reminder: design-sync scheduled for 16:00 today in #marketing. :bell: (auto)
Nina Patel: next steps: Ben upload comps by EOD, Sam finalize CSV + two slice variants (interactive vs batch), Priya draft lead routing + email copy, Marta draft the two post options. sync at 4pm. thanks! :party:
